cc:Work.dc:title: suite_ratios_baseline
cc:Work.dc:description: Each small point is one of ten paired block ratios. Diamonds and bars show the geometric mean and pointwise 95% Student-t interval on block log ratios; intervals are not simultaneous. The 26 prespecified suite tests form one Holm family; adjusted p values are in primary_contrasts.csv. Ratio >1 favors the GPU. Each session score sums six query medians from three inner actions; this is not an observed suite latency. Action time excludes startup. Blocks, rather than inner actions, are the inference units. Independent, approximately normal block log ratios are assumed; ten blocks do not guarantee power.

g.text: Single H100 study host · fixed configuration · four engine paths, five software configurations
Each small point is one of ten paired block ratios. Diamonds and bars show the geometric mean and pointwise 95% Student-t interval on block log ratios; intervals are not
simultaneous. The 26 prespecified suite tests form one Holm family; adjusted p values are in primary_contrasts.csv. Ratio >1 favors the GPU. Each session score sums six query
medians from three inner actions; this is not an observed suite latency. Action time excludes startup. Blocks, rather than inner actions, are the inference units. Independent,
approximately normal block log ratios are assumed; ten blocks do not guarantee power.
